protocol.label_source: Original mechanically verified ReasoningCorpus metadata, joined by exact example ID.
protocol.rescue: Selected raw answer correct, reference raw answer incorrect.
protocol.spoil: Selected raw answer incorrect, reference raw answer correct.

group_metrics.raw_accuracy: Fraction of four program variants with correct full-vocabulary argmax.
group_metrics.all_four_correct: All four input/answer-swap variants correct for one program.
group_metrics.swap_pair_both_correct: Fraction of the two inputs with both answer-order variants correct.
group_metrics.swap_pair_semantic_consistency: Fraction of two inputs whose two valid A/B predictions identify the same numeric choice; invalid predictions count as inconsistent.

protocol.route_swap_agreement: Fraction of input pairs receiving the same action before and after swapping answer order; differing actions are not automatically wrong.

confidence.unit: Complete program, all four variants retained together
confidence.interval: Paired program-bootstrap percentile 95%; unadjusted secondary diagnostics.

protocol.shuffle: Use only the one previously frozen whole-program score permutation in the evaluator. Verify global, label and slot action counts are preserved; no new permutations.
protocol.interpretation: Label/slot counterbalancing and label/slot-matched shuffling address simple answer-format routing. They do not prove logical reasoning, optimal geometry, or benefits on other tasks.

schema_adapter.reason: The model-facing ReasoningCorpus field projection omits choices, causing the original diagnostic to fail with KeyError before writing output.
schema_adapter.method: Original ReasoningCorpus verifies raw groups; restore original choices by exact example ID after checking each raw file hash and every projected metadata field.
